messages:
Janet: Quick note  update to PO rules for cloud credits and a short mid-year budget freeze window. Please read. :spiral_calendar:

Janet: 1) PO required for any cloud credit purchases or prepaid cloud commitments > $2,500. 2) Mid-year soft freeze: June 15-22  non-essential vendor approvals will be delayed.

Marco: Are credits treated like subscription renewals or one-offs? If we top up a committed account monthly, does that hit the freeze?

Janet: Good Q. Committed credits (multi-month contracts) are treated as contractual renewals if there is an existing agreement on file. One-off top-ups require a PO if >$2,500. If unsure, submit vendor form and mark "contractual" in the notes.

Ellen: For teams using prepaid reseller credits, who signs off? Product directors?

Janet: Director signoff for $2,500-$25,000. FP&A & Legal review for >$25,000. We'll add a signoff matrix in the portal.

FinanceBot: Automated reminder: outstanding PO requests for cloud credits: 3 pending older than 3 business days. (logged at 1802004555)

Sam: During the June 15-22 window, can we still submit vendor forms so they queue?

Janet: Yes  please submit as usual. Procurement will only expedite contractual or emergency requests during the freeze. Non-essential approvals will queue for processing after June 22.

Marco: Any change to corporate card usage for cloud purchases under $2,500?

Janet: Cards ok for purchases < $2,500 but receipts and project tag required within 5 business days. Repeated pattern of charges close to the threshold may trigger a review.

Ellen: Could we get a one-slide summary I can paste into the weekly manager digest?

Janet: I'll post a 1-slide summary + FAQ link to the finance portal by EOD. Link: <https://redwood.internal/finance/cloud-po-update|cloud PO update>.

Sam: Thanks, helps the teams plan.

Janet: Thanks everyone  ping @finance or DM me for edge cases.
